metadata.title: [SIP3.7] - Enable MERKL Rewards on all vault markets
metadata.description:
# [SIP3.7] - Enable MERKL Rewards on all vault markets
### 1. Overview:

This SIP relates to the RFC to transfer vault rewards from Lazy Summer Staking contracts to MERKL, which will allow the transferability, and as such, composability, of the Vault Tokens. Full details: [\[RFC\] Transfer Vault Rewards from staking to Merkl and enable tokenisation of Vault Shares](https://forum.summer.fi/t/rfc-transfer-vault-rewards-from-staking-to-merkl-and-enable-tokenisation-of-vault-shares/279)

This SIP and vote creates a MERKL campaign for each existing Lazy Vault, enabling rewards for another 90 days as the proposed rates described in the RFC.

It is then expected a follow up vote next Wednesday will enable the transferability of the Vault tokens to allow them to be used across DeFi and appear in the balance of user wallets.

### 2. Motivation:

In order to allow the vote shares to be used across DeFi, and to be trackable within Wallets, we need to move the existing vault reward infrastructure over to MERKL. This SIP, and subsequent vote creates the MERKL campaigns as the existing rewards come to an end from the 13th Aug 25 to 17th Aug 25.

### 3. Specification:

The following rewards are being setup, each to expire on the 11th November, and start on the current reward expiry date at 00:00 UTC

**ChainVaultCurrent Rewards EndCurrent SUMR APY @250MCurrent SUMR per dayProposed SUMR @ 25% APY**BaseUSDC13-Aug-2529.49%18,11115,354BaseEURC13-Aug-2525.28%6,0005,934BaseETH13-Aug-2513.09%18,11134,590ArbitrumUSDC15-Aug-2563.33%17,6946,985ArbitrumUSD₮015-Aug-2545.78%16,3898,950EthereumETH17-Aug-2516.75%67,611100,912EthereumETH (HR)17-Aug-2535.81%55,55638,785EthereumUSDC17-Aug-2522.39%55,55662,032EthereumUSDC (HR)18-Aug-2537.85%41,66727,521EthereumUSDT17-Aug-2543.71%34,25019,589SonicUSDC.e16-Aug-2519.53%10,04112,853

### 4. Risk Assessment:

No major risk exposure is expected. Merkl is a trusted application and used by many of the top tier protocols for distributing rewards.

### 5. Voting:

Should the delegates vote YES to this SIP, all of the merkl reward campaigns with the emissions set above will be created, and start on the current expiry date, and end on the 11th November 2025. This will transfer a total of 28,922,144 SUMR on Base to the merkl distribibution contracts.

A NO vote would lead to SUMR Vault Rewards ending throughout next week and no MERKL campaigns created.

# [SIP5.5.1] July Payouts for Referral Campaign (SIP5.5) 
# Summary

This sub-SIP details the payouts to be made for previously approved referral campaign, detailed here: [\[SIP5.5\] Enable onchain referrals and update AdmiralQuarters contracts on all chains to support Referral Codes](https://forum.summer.fi/t/sip5-5-enable-onchain-referrals-and-update-admiralquarters-contracts-on-all-chains-to-support-referral-codes/202)

The payouts are made on Base and include;

* 19,053.7651 SUMR Tokens
* 687.4849 USDC
* Total recipients: 226

* There are also MERKL Fee's so an additional 3% is added to USDC and SUMR amounts from the above.

# Technical details

The following payouts will be made as per this sheet - which details how much of each token the referring user and referred user earned as part of the campaign, and converts to USD at the time: [Lazy Summer Protocol Jun/Jul USDC and SUMR Referral Rewards - Google Sheets](https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/1_ZO7UXYJF9g4z8RUL8tvlmZDe-O6aK3835RJcR6AT5s/edit?usp=sharing)

# Specifications

Upon successful vote, it will trigger a campaign creation on MERKL and transfer the required amount of SUMR and USDC (plus fee's) to the claims contract which will then be made available to claim through the [Summer.fi](http://summer.fi/) UI when connecting their wallet.

metadata.title: SIP3.6: Delegate Rewards Distribution (July)
metadata.description:
# SIP3.6: Delegate Rewards Distribution (July)
### Overview:

This proposal continues the delegate compensation program first approved in [**\[SIP5.6\]**](https://forum.summer.fi/t/sip5-6-retroactive-compensation-for-delegates/229), this time applying it to **July 2025**. The goal is to sustain high-quality governance engagement and reward meaningful participation from active delegates across Lazy Summer Protocol governance.

***

### Motivation:

Engaged and accountable delegates are essential to the protocol’s health and evolution. July 2025 saw forum contributions and diverse delegate perspectives across proposals.

***

### Specification:

* Rewards Token: [**SUMR**](https://basescan.org/token/0x194f360D130F2393a5E9F3117A6a1B78aBEa1624)
* Source of Rewards: Lazy Summer [**DAO Treasury**](https://basescan.org/address/0x447bf9d1485abdc4c1778025dfdfbe8b894c3796) (Base)
* Total Distribution Amount: 129,499.97
* Distribution Schedule: One-time disbursement following onchain approval
* Eligibility Period: July 1st - July 31st (2025)
* Distribution Method: Direct transfer to verified delegate wallet addresses

***

### Risk Assessment:

* Onchain vote will authorize SUMR disbursement from DAO Treasury.
* Delegate participation data was sourced from the [**Lazy Summer Governance Dashboard**](https://dune.com/lazysummer/lazy-summer-dao-governance).
* The final delegate list and breakdown is publicly available [**here**](https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/e/2PACX-1vTOcW98nSMK1XdSVZ268c3M6MCqY-xvlr7Ji1GUjk0v9V_iXJfrpqE1wxJW1JcvRAaSb6LApoz3xonx/pubhtml).
* Any entity may only receive compensation through a single verified delegate address.
* Suspected Sybil delegates will be excluded if verified by [@Recognized\_Delegates](https://forum.summer.fi/groups/recognized_delegates).

***

### Voting:

> If **YES** - Approve 129,499.97 SUMR disbursement to eligible July delegates

> If **NO** - Do not compensate for July; continue with further discussion.

metadata.title: [SIP5.8] SUMR TR-WG Charter
metadata.description:
# [SIP5.8] SUMR TR-WG Charter
### 1. Overview:

This proposal stems from [**\[RFC\] SUMR Transfer Readiness Working Group**](https://forum.summer.fi/t/rfc-sumr-transfer-readiness-working-group/285), focusing on formal ratification of the working group Charter.

***

### 2. Objective:

Define a credible, milestone-based, and pragmatic roadmap for enabling SUMR token transfers that are aligned with protocol maturity, ecosystem readiness, and DAO consensus.

***

### 3. Scope:

* Develop a Readiness Checklist outlining the gating conditions required for SUMR transferability.
* Deliver associated governance proposals (SIPs), timelines, and implementation suggestions.
* Ensure broad community alignment via clear narrative and async updates.

***

### 4. Task Categories:

* **Coordination:** ops, updates, scheduling, synthesis
* **Governance & Checklist:** readiness framework, SIPs
* **Tokenomics & Liquidity:** modeling, thresholds, emissions
* **Tech & Protocol:** smart contract implications, feasibility, integrations
* **Narrative & Comms:** messaging, rollout story

***

### 5. Members & Roles:

* **Coordination:** [@jensei](https://forum.summer.fi/u/jensei) (SummerFi)
* **Governance & Checklist:** [@rspa\_StableLab](https://forum.summer.fi/u/rspa_stablelab) (StableLab), [@vumichien](https://forum.summer.fi/u/vumichien) (Community), [@MasterMojo](https://forum.summer.fi/u/mastermojo) (Community), Jengajojo (DAOplomats)
* **Tokenomics & Liquidity:** [@chrisb](https://forum.summer.fi/u/chrisb) (SummerFi), [@crunchy\_vertex](https://forum.summer.fi/u/crunchy_vertex) (Community), [@TokenBrice](https://forum.summer.fi/u/tokenbrice) (DeFi Collective), [@BaptistellaLabs](https://forum.summer.fi/u/baptistellalabs) (Baptistella Labs)
* **Tech & Protocol:** [@halaprix](https://forum.summer.fi/u/halaprix) (SummerFi), [@FBrinkkemper](https://forum.summer.fi/u/fbrinkkemper) (Community)
* **Narrative & Comms:** [@Sixty](https://forum.summer.fi/u/sixty) (Community), [@samehueasyou](https://forum.summer.fi/u/samehueasyou) (SummerFi), [@Eren\_DAOplomats](https://forum.summer.fi/u/eren_daoplomats) (DAOplomats), Ian (Community)

> *\*Subject to slight adjustments, mainly around external consultants.*

***

### 6. Timeline:

* **23.07.2025:** Confirm contributors, draft charter, draft checklists
* **25.07.2025:** Publish charter on gov. forum
* **28.07.2025 - 01.08.2025:** Finalize and publish master checklist (made of per-category checklists) on gov. forum
* **04.08.2025 - 08.08.2025:** Develop strategies, iterate checklists (if needed)
* **04.08.2025:** Publish final deliverables on gov. forum
* **11.08.2025 - 15.08.2025:** Create onchain proposals

***

### 7. Operating Model:

* **Communication:** Discord, Google Meet, Forum
* **Meetings:** Async update from each group, Check-in/alignment calls
* **Publishing:** Updates and final deliverables posted on the [Forum](https://forum.summer.fi/) and [Tally](https://gov.summer.fi/)
* **Documentation:** Google Docs

***

### 8. Budget & Compensation:

* Total of up to 120,000 SUMR
* Up to 10,000 SUMR per contributor (community/external)
  * Excluding SummerFi team
* One-time payment based on participation level
* Paid from Lazy Summer DAO Treasury via SIP

***

### 9. Deliverables Summary:

* **TR-WG Charter:** Forum posts ratifying the working group
* **Readiness Checklist:** Objective criteria to activate SUMR transfers (across categories)
* **Activation Plan:** Timeline and staged steps
* **Comms Summary:** Messaging guidance for community
* **Concrete SIPs:** Improvement proposals across categories

***

### 10. Termination Clause:

* Working Group sunsets automatically after delivery, unless extended.
* If deliverables fall behind, governance may restructure the group.

***

### 11. Voting:

> If **YES** - Ratify this working group Charter.

> If **NO** - Do not ratify this working group Charter; continue with further discussion.

***

metadata.title: [SIP5.10] Whitelist multiple addresses on SUMR token
metadata.description:
# [SIP5.10] Whitelist multiple addresses on SUMR token
**Title:** [\[SIP5.10\] Whitelist multiple addresses on SUMR token for MERKL reward transfer and other rewards](https://forum.summer.fi/t/sip5-10-whitelist-multiple-addresses-on-sumr-token-for-merkl-reward-transfer-and-other-rewards/314)



### 1. Overview:

In order to prepare for the transfer of SUMR Vault Rewards to MERKL, I am proposing we whitelist the relevant contracts now to finalise testing before the formal vote to transfer the rewards next Friday (8th Aug).

Within this vote, I also propose whitelisting another basic rewards contract that [Summer.fi](http://summer.fi/) will also use to distribute other rewards for various marketing and growth campaigns.

***

2\. Motivation:

As mentioned recently in the latest update within the RFC to Transfer Vault rewards to Merkl ( [\[RFC\] Transfer Vault Rewards from staking to Merkl and enable tokenisation of Vault Shares](https://forum.summer.fi/t/rfc-transfer-vault-rewards-from-staking-to-merkl-and-enable-tokenisation-of-vault-shares/279) ) this is expected to go to vote on the 8th August. In preperation for this, we would like to whitelist the relevant contracts prior on the SUMR token to ensure we are fully setup and ready to go and can do some simple tests on the frontend before it officially launches to the public.

At [Summer.fi](http://summer.fi/), while whitelisting, we would also like to propose adding another address to enable the rewarding of SUMR tokens for marketing and growth campaigns handled by [Summer.fi](http://summer.fi/) too, so are all proposed together in this sheet - for things like the RAYS campaign and some previous and upcoming L3 campaigns.

***

### 3. Specification:

The following addresses will be whitelisted in relation to the Merkl rewards transfer;

- `0x3Ef3D8bA38EBe18DB133cEc108f4D14CE00Dd9Ae` (the contract distributing the tokens to users)

- `0x8BB4C975Ff3c250e0ceEA271728547f3802B36Fd` (the contract you call when creating a campaign)

The following address will be used to offer rewards to users through campaigns setup by [Summer.fi](http://summer.fi/);

- `0xfb9a156f6e1c27acf4acea019a2629f02b467251`

These will all be whitelisted on the Base Network only.

***

### 4. Risk Assessment:

There is not considered to be any risk created by whitelisting these addresses.

***

### 5. Voting:

A successful YES vote would whitelist the addresses laid out in section 3, and allow the full testing and further vote on Friday 8th August to go ahead as planned for the transfer of Vault Rewards to Merkl.

metadata.title: # SIP5.9: Multi-Chain AdmiralsQuarters Role Setup
metadata.description:
# SIP5.9: Multi-Chain AdmiralsQuarters Role Setup

## Summary
This proposal grants the ADMIRALS_QUARTERS_ROLE to newly deployed AdmiralsQuarters contracts across all active chains in the Lazy Summer Protocol ecosystem.

## Motivation
The AdmiralsQuarters contract requires the ADMIRALS_QUARTERS_ROLE in the ProtocolAccessManager to operate properly. This role is necessary for the contract to unstake and withdraw assets from fleets on behalf of users.

Newly deployed AdmiralsQuarters contracts:
- base: 0x4e92071F9BC94011419Dc03fEaCA32D11241313a
- arbitrum: 0x1db04f01386c6BE2d22b7947236d8ACc05901219
- mainnet: 0xD03bD9Ef8c72Aee3DBb5b8DF83c479D847622Dba
- sonic: 0xa514a99b3584D152b2BE9cBe3e7B34Ad40954410



## Specifications

### Actions
1. On base: 
   - Grant ADMIRALS_QUARTERS_ROLE to AdmiralsQuarters at 0x4e92071F9BC94011419Dc03fEaCA32D11241313a

2. Send cross-chain proposal to arbitrum to:
   - Grant ADMIRALS_QUARTERS_ROLE to AdmiralsQuarters at 0x1db04f01386c6BE2d22b7947236d8ACc05901219

2. Send cross-chain proposal to mainnet to:
   - Grant ADMIRALS_QUARTERS_ROLE to AdmiralsQuarters at 0xD03bD9Ef8c72Aee3DBb5b8DF83c479D847622Dba

2. Send cross-chain proposal to sonic to:
   - Grant ADMIRALS_QUARTERS_ROLE to AdmiralsQuarters at 0xa514a99b3584D152b2BE9cBe3e7B34Ad40954410


## Technical Details
The ADMIRALS_QUARTERS_ROLE is defined in the ProtocolAccessManager contract and is specifically designed for the AdmiralsQuarters contract. This role enables the contract to perform unstaking and withdrawal operations from fleets on behalf of users.

When a user interacts with the AdmiralsQuarters interface to withdraw assets from fleets, the contract uses this role to execute the necessary transactions, ensuring a streamlined user experience while maintaining proper access controls.

metadata.title: SIP5.6: Compensation for Delegates
metadata.description:
# SIP5.6: Compensation for Delegates
### Summary

This proposal sets out a framework to compensate active delegates for their governance participation from the Lazy Summer DAO treasury, retroactively covering **March, April, and May 2025**. The methodology stems from the RFC discussions ([**RFC: Compensation for Delegates**](https://forum.summer.fi/t/rfc-compensation-for-delegates/193)) posted by [@chrisb](https://forum.summer.fi/u/chrisb) and aims to both reward consistency and increase future alignment.

This compensation program reflects our core belief that well-informed, active governance deserves support and now, with improved transparency through our WIP Dune dashboard (huge thanks to [@techsqrt](https://forum.summer.fi/u/techsqrt)), we’re ready to move forward with this implementation.

### Motivation

Governance cannot thrive without engaged, accountable delegates. With this SIP, I seek to formalize compensation for those who show up consistently and thoughtfully in both votes and discussions.

By rewarding delegates who maintain high participation and also drive forum engagement, we build stronger continuity, increase DAO memory, and lower governance friction over time.

### Methodology

Compensation is based on **delegated voting power**, **monthly average voting participation**, and **community engagement**. Here’s how it breaks down:

#### 1. **Delegate Tiering (by voting power)**

Based on average delegated SUMR tokens per month:

TierVoting PowerCompensationTier 1>35M SUMR12,000 SUMR/monthTier 2>100K SUMR7,500 SUMR/monthTier 3>10K SUMR3,000 SUMR/monthTier 4\<10K SUMR0 SUMR/month (ineligible)

#### 2. **Voting Participation Adjustment**

For each month, delegates are evaluated by their vote participation rate:

Participation %Payout % of Base Tier> 90%100%75–90%80%50–75%50%\< 49%0% (ineligible)

#### 3. **Activity Boost**

An additional **20,000 SUMR/month** will be distributed equally to all eligible delegates who meet at least one of the following:

* 100% monthly voting participation
* 20+ Forum comments
* 1+ Forum topic created

### Implementation

* **Payment Source:** Lazy Summer DAO Treasury Base ([**0x447BF9d1485ABDc4C1778025DfdfbE8b894C3796**](https://basescan.org/address/0x447BF9d1485ABDc4C1778025DfdfbE8b894C3796))
* **Payment Token:** SUMR
* **Payment Timeline:** One-time retroactive payment covering March, April, and May 2025
  (going forward either on monthly or quarterly basis)
* **Eligibility Cutoff:** Delegates with at least 10K SUMR delegated during the relevant month(s)

### Data & Transparency

The total distributed amounts will look as follows:

Month (2025)ProposalsEligible DelegatesSubtotalFebruary2--March814118,111 SUMRApril714113,500 SUMRMay813126,586 SUMR**TOTAL358,197 SUMR**

All delegate data is sourced from the upcoming [**Lazy Summer DAO Governance Dune Dashboard**](https://dune.com/lazysummer/lazy-summer-dao-governance), currently in development by [@techsqrt](https://forum.summer.fi/u/techsqrt). This gives real-time transparency into voting behavior, power distribution, and forum activity.

You can view the full breakdown of eligible delegates and monthly calculations in this public spreadsheet: [**Delegate Compensation Breakdown – March–May 2025**](https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/e/2PACX-1vTOcW98nSMK1XdSVZ268c3M6MCqY-xvlr7Ji1GUjk0v9V_iXJfrpqE1wxJW1JcvRAaSb6LApoz3xonx/pubhtml)

***

> \*Based on suggestion of [@FBrinkkemper](https://forum.summer.fi/u/fbrinkkemper), I ask all [@Recognized\_Delegates](https://forum.summer.fi/groups/recognized_delegates) to keep track of people trying to game the system. If anyone recognizes such case, please do report on it so we can take preventive steps for future compensation of such delegate.

## For now I suggest formally including a rule that says any entity can only be responsible for a single delegate account. If duplicates are found, any grant is immediately zeroed.
